review.brief: Review RM39 tier 4 (RM39-telemetry-move-to-own-schema), diff ffcb7e2..HEAD. Gate items, hardest first. (1) CATALOG COMPLETENESS is the one that failed last time: tier 3 shipped, passed review AND archived with five constraints still misnamed, because Postgres auto-names one CHECK per inline column constraint and those names live only in pg_constraint. Check all 9 objects in design D7 against the migration, and check the Down reverses them in the exact opposite order with no CASCADE. (2) DB matches the OWNER-CONFIRMED design (decision C1/roadmap D29) - any deviation is a BLOCKER, not a nit. Index plan promised nothing added or dropped and every statement catalog-only. (3) D6's INTENTIONAL HALF-STATE: SuperchargerReader, its four SuperchargerSessions* methods, NewSuperchargerReader, superchargerReader, rowToSuperchargerSession, upsertSuperchargerSession MUST still carry their old names. A finding that says 'rename these for consistency' is WRONG and will be rejected - that is tier 5. (4) RAW TEST SQL (D9) is this tier's central risk: invisible to sqlc and go vet. Verify the 41 statements across 7 telemetry test files plus the cross-module ones in charging/analytics are all schema-qualified and name supercharger_history. (5) D10: no search_path was added anywhere. A bare supercharger_sessions resolved through a search_path including charging would silently read CHARGING's table and pass while asserting the wrong data. (6) T8's three guarded mappings in charging's backfill replay, especially the to_regclass one - a miss fails SILENTLY on empty assertions. (7) T8.6 changed comments ONLY inside the shipped migration 20260823000001 - verify zero SQL lines moved. (8) TEST QUALITY BY READING, NOT RUNNING: confirm the test edits assert the values design.md's Test Contract authored BEFORE implementation, not values derived from the implementation. Zero expected assertion values should have changed - this tier renames, it does not change behavior. (9) Performance-Profile (read-heavy): confirm no query shape, predicate or plan changed. (10) Docs rule: structure docs AND kkpa/context/ updated in the same change; check the discrimination rule was applied per occurrence (telemetry's mentions renamed, charging's own supercharger_sessions left alone, analytics' watermark vocabulary untouched). (11) ANTI-GAMING: no acceptance criterion weakened or deleted, no status self-approved. TEST-EXECUTION-POLICY (verbatim): Claude writes tests but never runs the suite - never go test ./..., make test, make test-with-db or make check. It MAY run go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l, make build, make vet, make bins, and the standalone guards. The owner runs the suite and reports results. SIGNAL PROVENANCE: assistant-run = go build ./..., go vet ./... repo-wide, gofmt -l, make migration-guard/boundary-guard/tz-guard/money-guard, all green. USER-REPORTED = `make test` (full suite, disposable postgres:16-alpine) PASSING, reported by the owner on 2026-09-03. You must NOT run any suite; judge test quality by reading.
